about: Goal: remove a Minister from their seat with an Intrigue card.
Goal: be a Minister when Hıyanet is played.
Goal: be a Minister when Hizmet is played.
Goal: play Intrigue cards on 3 different players, not counting yourself.
Goal: be appointed Minister in 2 different crises.
Goal: have other players play 2 or more Intrigue cards on you in the same crisis.
Goal: play a muhur or kefalet card on a Minister.
Goal: play 3 Intrigue cards in one crisis.
Goal: become a Minister through an Intrigue card.
Goal: use an information card: casus, muhurlu-evrak, teftis or nobet.
